text:
ashley: FYI customer AtlasAI reporting intermittent 504s on hosted /v1/stream. Started ~10:03 UTC, ~2% of requests over last 30m. Affected: long streaming generations (seq len 512+). @jordan oncall?
jordan: looking now
sre-bot: alert: hosted-gateway 504 spike detected (1749123456)
jordan: grabbing gateway traces and runtime logs — seeing increased backend tail latency on devpool-gpu-3, p99 ~1.2s, many requests queued
mike: any auth/billing errors in the trace?
devon: support pulled customer logs — noticed repeated 401s then retries then 504s. Customer uses short-lived tokens with aggressive refresh at t+30s. SDK retry window seems to collide with refresh bursts
ashley: repro snippet from customer: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"<long prompt>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream  (they're streaming long tokens)
jordan: confirmed retry amplification. auth proxy returns 502 for a short window, client SDK concurrently retries -> amplifies load to runtime and gateway queueing
mike: temp mitigation idea: enable per-account circuit breaker + throttle for AtlasAI. Limit concurrent to 12, cooldown 30s. I'll roll a targeted circuit-breaker rule now
devon: support: pinged AtlasAI to add client-side jitter/backoff in their SDK and to pause rapid concurrent retries while we triage
ashley: longer-term: consider automatic fallback to smaller model for heavy seq-length streaming requests to reduce per-token runtime pressure
mike: agreed. propose routing policy: if gateway queue depth > 80% for account, route to model-small-1 and add X-Redwood-Fallback header. I'll draft PR
jordan: action items (short list): 1) deploy circuit breaker for atlas-account (mike) 2) add auth-refresh histogram + alert on proxy 502 bursts (devon) 3) implement fallback routing + header (mike) 4) update incident playbook and customer comms (ashley)
devon: I'll draft the customer note acknowledging the outage, recommended SDK backoff patch, and short-term mitigations
mike: opened PR infra#4322 for targeted CB and routing config (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4322)
sre-bot: deploy status: circuit-breaker rollout complete at 1749123720 (targeted to atlas-account)
ashley: monitoring: p50/p95 latencies improving after CB. Keeping channel open for postmortem and followups
jordan: assigning RCA/writeup for tomorrow morning to devon + mike. We should capture root cause: auth refresh spike -> retry amplification -> runtime queue overload -> 504s
devon: added tasks to support board: PW-987 (customer comms) and PW-988 (auth proxy alerting)
ashley: also add checklist item: SDKs should default to exponential backoff+jitter when auth refresh occurs. We'll add to devex docs
mike: will add metric: per-account concurrent inflight + fallback count. Also add alert when fallback route exceeds 5% of traffic
ashley: thanks all :thumbsup: We'll run a short postmortem doc and share with support and eng tomorrow
